about: Ten construction phrases for the Whisper glossary eval (scripts/voice_wer_eval.py), plus a language guard. Record each as <id>.ogg/.m4a/.mp3 in one folder (a WhatsApp voice note, exported, is the real thing), or let --tts read them aloud. 01 is the live miss from 588, Oct 11.

phrases.text: I'll send the window shop drawings tomorrow
The rebar inspection is Thursday morning, DOB is coming at eight
We need to core drill the sleeves for the sprinkler risers on three
Sheetrock is done on four, fire stopping starts Monday
Can Rivera Electric send the submittal for the panel by Friday
The pour is pushed to Tuesday, formwork isn't ready
Scaffolding comes down after the facade inspection
Meilich, the calcs for the steel are still missing
Punch list walk with the architect before the TCO
Make sure everyone has their SST card at the hoist

language_guard.text: Mañana llega la varilla para el tercer piso
El colado se pasa al jueves, la cimbra no está lista
